correctness.rationale: The Frucht graph is defined by its exact sorted list of 18 edges on 12 vertices, and the ordinary matching complex K=M(F)=Ind(L(F)) has one vertex per graph edge. It is flag, and any induced support carrying nonzero reduced H_d has ≥2d+2 vertices by the minimal-support vertex-link exact sequence and the cone obstruction; equality forces the boundary of the (d+1)-cross-polytope. For d=3 the minimum is 8. Equality carriers in a matching complex correspond exactly to four pairs of incident graph edges with disjoint vertex supports, i.e. four vertex-disjoint P3 paths covering all 12 vertices. The 36 incident-edge pairs yield exactly 87 4-path packings; independent enumeration reproduced 87. The exact f-vector (18,117,333,397,152,8) and boundary ranks (17,100,233,144,8) were independently reconstructed over F2,F3,F5,F101 and source-provided arbitrary-integer ±1-pivot eliminations inspected. The quotient calculation gives free reduced H3=Z20 with other reduced homology zero and no integral torsion because all pivots are integral units. Each octahedral fundamental cycle is an oriented join of four 0-cycles with 16 signed tetrahedra. Their reductions mod im ∂4 each have primitive coordinate gcd and the 87 classes yield 20 additional unit pivots, an integral basis obtained by 20 source-verified unit pivots. Independent modular augmented rank tests give increment 20 over each of F2,F3,F5,F101, corroborating but not replacing integral primality. The finite object is exhaustively computable; no extension to infinite graph classes is claimed.
residual_risks: Finite numerical/modular experiments corroborate but do not substitute for analytic or integer-exact proofs.

originality.rationale: The standard M(4P3)=S3 cross-polytope fact is explicitly prior, and classical matching/chessboard connectivity does not calculate the Frucht ambient homology map. Frucht independence-complex reports use Ind(F), not Ind(L(F)); Franklin graph and other 12-vertex cubic matching complexes are distinct. The new conclusion is not merely that an octahedral support exists: it is the exact 87 carrier census, primitive inclusion images and integral rank-20 generation. Historical separate-graph tables could be latent risk but no covering result identified.
residual_risks: No claim of exhaustively checking every small-graph computational-homology database or all unindexed theses.

value.rationale: The Frucht graph is the canonical smallest asymmetric cubic graph, a natural finite test object with no symmetry to trivialize cycles. The minimal induced-homology support and explicit integral generating set distinguish local sphere carriers from ambient chain topology; primitivity and full integral span are not routine deductions from the graph size or face vector. Exact finite classification is independently useful without demanding a new theorem over all graphs.
residual_risks: Value assessment is confined to the exact claimed object/family and is not a claim of general classification beyond its scope.

limitations: Independent assessment based on explicitly reconstructed mathematics and actual package files; repository script outputs are corroboration, not proof.
